businessDifference.conflictSummary: 当前实现只记住上一张 task box 是否为暗雷，变化一次后即失去暗雷历史，后续子任务仍会重复模板/OCR 分类。
businessDifference.userDecision: 一次李靖接任务周期中只允许识别一次暗雷；首次确认后后续不同 task box 全部跳过暗雷模板和 OCR，同一暗雷 task box 保持原分支，下一次成功接任务 title 才重置。2026-08-14 进一步裁决：不加多模板，暗雷图片阈值改为 0.65；已隔离 task-box OCR 包含单个‘暗’字也算暗雷，同时保留‘雷战’判据。

connectivity.producer: Client WindowObservationSampler 在引妖香专用或天庭 recovery 探针中 fresh 复核 yinyao.png，并且真实物理点击成功后上报 tianting.yinyao|executed=true。
connectivity.transport: TIANTING_YINYAO 或按周期选择的 TIANTING_RECOVERY_OPTION / TIANTING_RECOVERY_OPTION_NO_YINYAO interest；CloudWholeTaskReadyEventState 以 exact SlotKey 持久保存本接任务周期的引妖香 consumed latch。
connectivity.consumer: TiantingTask 消费成功 action 后置位 latch；战后 probe 和后续 recovery 在武装前读取 latch，已置位时分别跳过专用探针并改用排除引妖香的 recovery 集。
connectivity.ordering: fresh accepted title resets latch -> post-combat/no-movement may arm yinyao-capable probe -> fresh local click succeeds -> Cloud consumes exact action and latches -> later probes in same accepted cycle exclude yinyao -> next fresh accepted title alone resets

proves: 普通 recovery 仍可命中引妖香
周期锁置位后的 recovery operation 排除引妖香但保留其他天庭业务选项
只有真实消费 tianting.yinyao 才锁存
同周期后续战后 probe 被跳过且暂停恢复不重置
fresh accepted title 清锁并重新允许一次匹配

connectivity.producer: CloudWholeTaskObserver 对同一次 Tracker 分析的暗雷模板结果，或同 actionId/task-box/generation 的 definitive OCR 暗雷结果。
connectivity.transport: CloudWholeTaskReadyEventState 以 tenant/user/device/window SlotKey 保存 generation、暗雷已出现标记和原始 task-box fingerprint；该槽不随 observation run 注销，异步 OCR 携带 generation。
connectivity.consumer: CloudWholeTaskObserver 在分析前关闭后续暗雷模板/OCR；TiantingTask 点击前以 slot snapshot 和 task-box 原图比较保留当前暗雷或强制后续普通分支；awaitAcceptedTitle 成功后重置 generation。
connectivity.ordering: fresh accepted title resets generation and clears its old-generation prepared action -> next Tracker frame is reclassified under the new generation -> first dark template/OCR marks slot -> same task box remains dark -> later different task boxes skip template and OCR -> next fresh accepted title alone resets; stale generation OCR drops

proves: template and OCR both mark the slot-scoped round latch
same task box remains DARK_THUNDER while later changed task boxes are ordinary
classification is skipped after the latch and pause/unregister does not erase it
only successful accepted title advances generation, discards the old-generation action and waits for fresh reclassification
stale OCR cannot publish or be consumed by the new generation

connectivity.producer: Client WindowObservationSampler 对 exact pathing intent 连续读取有效逻辑坐标；任意一次 X/Y 变化后锁存 coordinateMovementObserved。
connectivity.transport: WindowPathingSnapshot -> TurnPathingSnapshot / ObservationPathingFact；两仓同步 coordinateMovementObserved 字段合同，只传 Runner 的锁存布尔，不传派生移动时间戳。
connectivity.consumer: Cloud G017UnknownPhaseRecoveryPolicy、TiantingTask 和 TeamReturnService 只消费 coordinateMovementObserved，不按像素差、等待时长、最终坐标或任务分支重建移动真值。
connectivity.ordering: intent 注册并以当前/最后已知逻辑坐标建立本地基线 -> Runner 持续观察同 intent -> 任意坐标变化锁存 true -> 终态携带锁存事实 -> Cloud 才决定 MOVED 或 NO_MOVEMENT

proves: 点击时已有逻辑坐标可作为 intent 内第一份比较基线
任意有效 X/Y 变化锁存 coordinateMovementObserved
地图 OCR 文本变化和像素差不能伪造移动
exact terminal 只按 Runner 锁存布尔区分 MOVED/NO_MOVEMENT
暗雷不再绕过统一移动合同
